description: The first GitHub Pages deployment remained queued in the Pages backend until actions/deploy-pages reached its 600-second timeout. The dashboard build and uploaded Pages artifact had completed successfully.
response: A failed-job rerun was attempted; GitHub immediately canceled the same canceled deployment version. A new tracked deployment-artifact revision was created so Pages could receive a fresh build version without changing analytical or visual content.

description: The fresh Pages deployment version also remained queued for the full 600-second default action timeout. The second dashboard build and Pages artifact upload again completed successfully.
response: The Pages deployment action timeout was increased from 600000 to 1800000 milliseconds so the external Pages backend can finish without rerunning or altering analytical content.
